key_property: Style Jailbreak sends only chat queries to the target: no attacker model, no weights/logits/gradients, one reusable offline style graph amortized across all goals and targets

target_queries_per_goal_advbench.note: easy targets often succeed during warmup, near one query; target-query count is comparable to attacker-model baselines, so it is not the main source of savings

wallclock_advbench_hours.note: removing the second attacker model is the main end-to-end time saving; each baseline target query is preceded by a separate attacker-model generation with extra tokens, latency, and rate limits

wallclock_trustllm.note: on the harder TrustLLM goals the gap widens; TAP's search tree grows to nearly thirty queries and over fifty hours

automation: fully automatic: no attacker model to configure and no human tuning per goal; the offline style map and fixed two-turn frame are reused for every goal and target
